message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/libopensc/pkcs15.c","function":"sc_pkcs15_get_lastupdate","line":538,"var":"content","code":"content = calloc(size, 1);","note":"Attacker-controlled tokeninfo file size determines the heap buffer used to hold the ASN.1 blob read from the card/file."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/libopensc/pkcs15.c","function":"sc_pkcs15_get_lastupdate","line":543,"var":"content_len","code":"r = sc_read_binary(p15card->card, 0, content, size, 0);","note":"The raw file bytes are copied into content and the returned length becomes the input length for ASN.1 decoding."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/libopensc/pkcs15.c","function":"sc_pkcs15_get_lastupdate","line":548,"var":"asn1_last_update","code":"sc_format_asn1_entry(asn1_last_update + 0, last_update, &lupdate_len, 0);","note":"The decoder is configured to write the GeneralizedTime value into a fixed 32-byte stack buffer last_update."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/libopensc/pkcs15.c","function":"sc_pkcs15_get_lastupdate","line":550,"var":"sc_asn1_decode(...)","code":"r = sc_asn1_decode(ctx, asn1_last_update, content, content_len, NULL, NULL);","note":"Untrusted ASN.1 content is parsed and dispatched to the ASN.1 entry decoder for the lastUpdate field."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/libopensc/asn1.c","function":"asn1_decode_entry","line":1570,"var":"parm","code":"case SC_ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME:","note":"The GeneralizedTime branch treats entry->parm as the destination buffer and uses the caller-provided length pointer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/libopensc/asn1.c","function":"asn1_decode_entry","line":1582,"var":"c","code":"c = *len = objlen; parm = *buf;","note":"For allocated destinations the code records the full ASN.1 object length, but for the stack-backed last_update buffer the effective copy size is still derived from objlen."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/libopensc/asn1.c","function":"asn1_decode_entry","line":1588,"var":"memcpy(parm, obj, c)","code":"memcpy(parm, obj, c);","note":"The decoder copies objlen bytes into the fixed-size last_update buffer without enforcing the 32-byte limit, causing the stack-buffer-overflow read/write condition reported by ASAN."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/candidate_trace.json written')
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
